text:
Maria: Window-side wifi experiment. Moved the little satellite dish to the balcony, angled it at ~15°, propped a mirror behind it to reflect router signal (don’t ask), and left my kiddo’s rubber duck for moral support. Cat insisted on sitting on the antenna. Pics: <image uploaded>
Ben: omg the duck is leadership. did it help?
Maria: speeds kinda up in the living room (quick speedtest):
```
Ping: 18 ms
Download: 130 Mbps
Upload: 12 Mbps
```
Liam: those numbers are solid for a patchwork solution :joy: Try 5GHz if nearby neighbors crowd 2.4.
Maria: 2.4 was awful, 5G picked up once I nudged it 2ft left. Cat unplugged it at 9:03am though :cry: 
Zoe: bring the cat into the ops rotation — we've had worse oncall coverage :stuck_out_tongue: 
Ben: also try a channel scan: `sudo iwlist wlan0 scan | grep Frequency`
Maria: hehe opsbot, any quick diagnostics? @OpsBot run internet-health Maria
OpsBot: @Maria Running quick diagnostics... packet loss 0%, jitter 3ms, nearest AP overlap: 4 networks on channel 36
Maria: aha so overlap on 5G too, will try channel 40. thanks :raised_hands: 
Liam: also powerline adapters saved me when the router refused to be polite.
Maria: true. there’s like one old ethernet jack under the couch with 30 dust bunnies between me and glory
Ben: send pic of cat on antenna pls :heart_eyes: 
Maria: uploaded `maria-cat-antenna.jpg` — it’s glorious, she looks like a tiny satellite
Zoe: quick poll: should Maria name the duck 'Routerus'? :duck: :thumbsup: for yes
Ben: +1
Liam: +1
Maria: Routerus it is. Will report back after relocating to channel 40. :rocket:
